    How to use it
    
        
      
          
    1. Drop or choose one picture (or try the sample).
      2. 
          
    2. Crop, pad, round the corners and pick a background.
      3. 
          
    3. Check every icon, including the maskable safe zone.
      4. 
          
    4. Download all, then paste the tags into your page.
      5. 
        
    
        
    
          
    Do thisPhoneKeyboard
    
          
            
    Add a pictureTap Choose a pictureTab to it, Enter (or Ctrl + V)
    
            
    Padding, cornersDrag the sliders← →
    
            
    BackgroundTap the colour, or type a hexTab to the hex box, type
    
            
    Get one iconTap its ↓Tab to it, Enter
    
            
    Copy the HTMLTap CopyTab to Copy, Enter
